drop_non_definition.note: A quoted term that is never classified as a definition is dropped: no DEFINITION and no USE.

parenthetical_introduction.note: Requires (the|a|an) immediately before the opening quote, so ("Parent"), (collectively, the "Parties"), and (each, a "Party") fail.

quoted_term_pattern.note: Accepts straight double and curly double quotes only. Omits straight and curly single quotes.
